core.title: Narrow Stile Rim Exit Device with Electronic Latch Retraction, Adams Rite 8800EL36

text.description_html:
ADA Adams Rite 8800EL36 Narrow Stile Rim Exit Device for Narrow Stile Doors

The 8800 Series Narrow Stile Rim Exit Device with Electronic Latch Retraction is designed for narrow stile single doors or pairs of doors with a mullion. The Starwheel locking bolt closes around strike when door is closed providing solid security and preventing jam spreading.
The Electronic Latch Retraction uses a solenoid mounted under the push bar for instantaneous unlocking and locking of the exit device from a remote location or access control device. Because electrical operation of device is fail-secure this option can be used on fire rated as well as life safety applications. In the event of a power failure, device automatically re-locks.

Specifications of the Adams Rite 8800 Narrow Stile Rim Exit Device:

  • Certified Grade 1 ANSI/BHMA A156.3
  • Finish: powder-coated Aluminum
  • Projection: 2-5/8” max., 1-5/8” dogged
  • Minimum Stile: 2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4” to 2-1/4"
  • Dogging: hex key standard
  • Handing: Non Handed
  • Packaged with all mounting hardware.

Sold Individually. Packaged as Exit Device Only - No Trim.

Special ordered item -- NO returns
